skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Conduct independent research, analyze data, and propose solutions based on findings.
Develop critical thinking skills to evaluate and solve problems in the insurance field.
Communicate effectively in professional settings, both written and oral.
Manage projects, including planning, execution, and evaluation.
Understand and apply knowledge of insurance policies, procedures, and market trends.
Analyze and implement insurance policies and strategies.
Collect, analyze, and interpret data to inform decision-making.
Write comprehensive and structured reports based on research findings.
Work collaboratively with peers and mentors to achieve project goals.
Demonstrate leadership in guiding and inspiring team members.
